previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted with subjective fevers and tenderness at the site of recent Port-A-Cath removal. She had a history of recent bacteremia and port infection, prompting evaluation for recurrence. Blood cultures remained negative, no fever was documented during admission, and labs showed resolving inflammation with elevated ESR and CRP likely due to recent surgery. Imaging revealed phlegmonous changes without abscess. She was not started on antibiotics, remained stable, and was discharged home on her prior medications with plans to follow up with her primary care provider. Her diabetes was managed with U500 insulin, and she continued her chronic pain and psychiatric medications without change.
problems: Diabetes with neurological manifestations, type I [juvenile type], not stated as uncontrolled
